_readme: Live eval for the events skill (npm run eval:events -- --live). Runs the whole pipeline against the saved UAB feed with its dates slid forward so the first event is today. expect: events_answer | events_not_found | handbook | not_events | escalate | any. mustMention/mustNotMention are regexes. Uses real API credit, so it needs a go-ahead.

cases.q: What's happening on campus this week?
Any comedy shows coming up?
Is there free food at any events?
What's UAB doing this weekend?
Any events about banned books?
Is there a concert coming up?
cases.note: the feed has a cellist show; either a match or an honest 'nothing found' is fine, but no invented concerts

cases.q: What events are going on tomorrow?
What about the day after?

history.text: What events are going on tomorrow?

cases.q: Is there anything about skydiving on campus?
What's happening on campus on January 3rd?
Can my friend stay over this weekend?

cases.q: Are candles allowed in my room?
What's for lunch today?
cases.note: dining is switched off in this eval, so this must not become an events answer
